# anthropic_webhook (Resource)

Beta. Manages an organization webhook endpoint (`/v1/organizations/webhooks`). Anthropic must turn the API on for the organization. Not available to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled. The signing secret is returned only on create.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_webhook" "example" {
  url         = "https://hooks.example.com/anthropic"
  name        = "example-hook"
  description = "Example webhook endpoint"
  enabled_events = [
    "user_profile.enforcement_action_opened",
    "user_profile.enforcement_action_resolved",
  ]
}

# The signing secret is returned only on create
output "webhook_signing_secret" {
  value     = anthropic_webhook.example.signing_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled_events` (Set of String) Event types delivered to the endpoint, for example `user_profile.enforcement_action_opened`, `user_profile.enforcement_action_resolved` or `user_profile.program_status_updated`.
- `url` (String) HTTPS URL that deliveries are sent to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Notes about the endpoint.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are sent. Anthropic can disable an endpoint on its own (see `disabled_reason`). The next apply re-enables it. Events that happen while disabled are never delivered.
- `name` (String) Short label for the endpoint.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the endpoint was created.
- `disabled_reason` (String) Why Anthropic disabled the endpoint automatically. Empty when enabled or disabled by you.
- `id` (String) ID of the webhook endpoint.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret Anthropic signs deliveries with (`whsec_...`). Returned only on create, and `null` after import.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the endpoint was last changed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The signing secret is not returned on import.
terraform import anthropic_webhook.example whep_01ABCDEF
```
